description: The roles of an ordinary review and which role's output each needs (D-S59 item 1, D-S55 item 5, D-S57 item 2), read by scripts/role_graph.py: checked for unknown roles and cycles, ordered topologically, and every run's execution_topology.json records the graph that ran beside its measured times and whether it kept these edges. An edge is a role that READS another's output, named with the code that reads it; a phase barrier the pipeline adds beyond these edges is not a dependency and is recorded as waiting, not refused. Which model a role runs on is config/agent_registry.json's (each agent's local block), never this file's. scope: document, an edge between tasks of the same document; corpus, between a corpus-level task and any.
